name: Heavy Support
strategy: Coordinate powerful battlefield assets, artillery, heavy attacks, and conventional forces providing support.

commands.name: Armored Advance
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +2" Move during its next normal Move this Round and Tough 1 against its next ranged Attack this Round.

commands.name: Fire Control
commands.effect: Choose one visible enemy Unit. The next Attack made against it by each of up to two different friendly Units this Phase gains Accurate 1.

commands.name: Battering Attack
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +1 Attack, Anti-Armored 1, and Anti-Monster 1 on its next Engagement Attack this Phase. Anti bonuses only apply against their respective target categories.

commands.name: Shock Support
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Charge 1 on its next Charge this Phase. If it begins that Charge within Short of a friendly Large Asset, it gains Charge 2 instead.

commands.name: Spotter's Call
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Accurate 2 and reduces the target's effective Cover X by 1 (minimum 0) on its next ranged Attack this Phase. If the attacker is Artillery or a Large Asset, it also gains +1 Attack.

doctrineIdentity: Concentrated force and coordination around powerful weapons or battlefield assets. Heavy Support is useful even without multiple Large Assets, but its additional A slots and selected bonuses reward armies investing in them.
